new.title: A finite bound on mixed cycle spaces missing a long alternating window of either parity
new.statement:
∀ (t d : ℕ), 4 ≤ t → 2 ≤ d →
  letI : ∀ p : Prop, Decidable p := Classical.propDecidable
  let F := ZMod 2
  let n := 6*t
  let a := 3*t
  let W := Fin n → F
  letI : Fintype (Submodule F W) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let next := fun i : Fin n =>
    (⟨(i.val+1) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) i.isLt)⟩ : Fin n)
  let h := fun (i : Fin n) (b : Fin 4) =>
    if i.val % 2 = b.val / 2 ∧ (i.val / 2 % 3 = b.val % 2 ∨ i.val / 2 % 3 = 2)
    then (1:F) else 0
  let good := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ b : Fin 4, (∑ i, h i b * x i) = 0) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i, x i * y (next i) = x (next i) * y i)
  let supp := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => ∃ x ∈ U, x i ≠ 0)
  let spaces := (Finset.univ : Finset (Submodule F W)).filter good
  let layer := spaces.filter (fun U : Submodule F W => Module.finrank F U = d)
  let mixed := layer.filter (fun U => ∀ b : Fin 2, ∃ i ∈ supp U, i.val % 2 = b.val)
  let B := ∏ i ∈ Finset.range d, (2^d-2^i : ℕ)
  let s := (2 : ℝ)^d
  let move := fun (i : Fin n) (j : Fin 24) =>
    (⟨(i.val+j.val) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) i.isLt)⟩ : Fin n)
  let window := fun (S : Finset (Fin n)) (b : Fin 2) =>
    ∃ i : Fin n, ∀ j : Fin 24, move i j ∈ S ↔ (move i j).val % 2 = b.val
  let bad := mixed.filter (fun U => ∃ b : Fin 2, ¬ window (supp U) b)
  (B : ℝ)*(bad.card : ℝ) ≤
    2*s^(a-2)*((1+24/s)^n-1) + (2 : ℝ)^n*s^(a-n/48)
new.unlocks: Controls the mixed near-alternating exceptions in the transition from pure parity lanes to supports that see both check planes.
new.context: Compare occupancy with even alternation. For c=a-j occupied runs the comparison has j intervals of each phase. If one phase has no 24-site window, record its j starts and lengths below 24. A window in the other phase supplies two independent singleton checks. Sum 2*choose(n,j)*24^j*s^(a-j-2). If neither phase has a window then n<=46j, so the crude bound on all 2^n words suffices. Full sketch in barriers/statements/graph-isotropic-code/short-phase-mass.sketch.txt.

new.title: Two full parity supports and a cyclic run weight describe the entire support census through the singular crossover
new.statement:
∀ T D : ℕ → ℕ, Filter.Tendsto T Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
  (∀ k, 2 ≤ D k) →
  Filter.Tendsto (fun k => (6*(T k : ℝ))/(2 : ℝ)^(D k)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
  Filter.Tendsto (fun k => (D k : ℝ)/(6*(T k : ℝ))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
  Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ =>
  letI : ∀ p : Prop, Decidable p := Classical.propDecidable
  let t := T k
  let d := D k
  let F := ZMod 2
  let n := 6*t
  let a := 3*t
  let W := Fin n → F
  letI : Fintype (Submodule F W) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let next := fun i : Fin n =>
    (⟨(i.val+1) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) i.isLt)⟩ : Fin n)
  let h := fun (i : Fin n) (b : Fin 4) =>
    if i.val % 2 = b.val / 2 ∧ (i.val / 2 % 3 = b.val % 2 ∨ i.val / 2 % 3 = 2)
    then (1:F) else 0
  let good := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ b : Fin 4, (∑ i, h i b * x i) = 0) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i, x i * y (next i) = x (next i) * y i)
  let supp := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => ∃ x ∈ U, x i ≠ 0)
  let spaces := (Finset.univ : Finset (Submodule F W)).filter good
  let layer := spaces.filter (fun U : Submodule F W => Module.finrank F U = d)
  let B := ∏ i ∈ Finset.range d, (2^d-2^i : ℕ)
  let s := (2 : ℝ)^d
  let lane := fun b : Fin 2 => Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i.val % 2 = b.val)
  let runs := fun S : Finset (Fin n) => (S.filter (fun i => next i ∉ S)).card
  let model := fun S : Finset (Fin n) =>
    (if S = lane 0 then s^(a-2) else 0) + (if S = lane 1 then s^(a-2) else 0) +
    (s-1)^(runs S)/s^4
  let actual := fun S : Finset (Fin n) => (B : ℝ) *
    ((layer.filter (fun U => supp U = S)).card : ℝ)
  (∑ S : Finset (Fin n), |actual S - model S|)/(∑ S : Finset (Fin n), model S))
    Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
new.unlocks: Describes the complete support distribution in the region where parity-lane concentration competes with the cyclic run weight.
new.context: Each pure lane has kernel dimension a-2 and its tuples miss any coordinate with probability 1/s. The short-phase mass bound controls irregular mixed supports. On every regular support, a nonzero matrix character hits at least six singleton runs in a 24-site parity window; each gives -1 in place of q. Summing characters leaves relative error at most (s^4-1)/q^6. Remove nonspanning tuples by the hyperplane trace with d-1 bits. Full sketch in barriers/statements/graph-isotropic-code/crossover-support.sketch.txt.

new.title: The mixed fraction and Gaussian fluctuations of the largest extension at the singular mixing threshold
new.statement:
∀ T D : ℕ → ℕ, Filter.Tendsto T Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
  (∀ k, 2 ≤ D k) →
  ∀ x : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => 6*(T k : ℝ)/Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^(D k))
    - 2*Real.log ((2 : ℝ)^(D k))) Filter.atTop (nhds x) →
  ∀ z : Option ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ =>
  letI : ∀ p : Prop, Decidable p := Classical.propDecidable
  let t := T k
  let d := D k
  let F := ZMod 2
  let n := 6*t
  let a := 3*t
  let W := Fin n → F
  letI : Fintype (Submodule F W) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let next := fun i : Fin n =>
    (⟨(i.val+1) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) i.isLt)⟩ : Fin n)
  let h := fun (i : Fin n) (b : Fin 4) =>
    if i.val % 2 = b.val / 2 ∧ (i.val / 2 % 3 = b.val % 2 ∨ i.val / 2 % 3 = 2)
    then (1:F) else 0
  let good := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ b : Fin 4, (∑ i, h i b * x i) = 0) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i, x i * y (next i) = x (next i) * y i)
  let supp := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => ∃ x ∈ U, x i ≠ 0)
  let spaces := (Finset.univ : Finset (Submodule F W)).filter good
  let layer := spaces.filter (fun U : Submodule F W => Module.finrank F U = d)
  let mixed := layer.filter (fun U => ∀ b : Fin 2, ∃ i ∈ supp U, i.val % 2 = b.val)
  let s := (2 : ℝ)^d
  let mu := (n : ℝ)/(1+Real.sqrt (s-1))
  let host := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    (spaces.filter (fun E : Submodule F W => U ≤ E)).sup (fun E => Module.finrank F E)
  let event : Finset (Submodule F W) := match z with
    | none => mixed
    | some y => mixed.filter (fun U =>
        (2*((a-host U : ℕ) : ℝ)-mu)/Real.sqrt mu ≤ y)
  (event.card : ℝ)/(layer.card : ℝ)) Filter.atTop
    (nhds ((Real.exp x/(2+Real.exp x)) * (match z with
      | none => 1
      | some y => ((ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1) (Set.Iic y)).toReal)))
new.unlocks: Identifies the threshold, its mixed probability and the fluctuation scale for a typical largest admissible extension.
new.context: The run trace divided by s^(n/2) is asymptotic to exp(n/sqrt(s)). Compare its four-check cost with two pure lanes at two-check cost. In the mixed component equal edges are binomial conditioned even. Consecutive defects have probability at most 2n/L^2, so all vacant gaps then have length at most two and 2(a-H) differs from the defect count by at most eight. Unimodality bounds parity bias of any binomial tail by twice its peak, yielding the normal limit. Full sketch in barriers/statements/graph-isotropic-code/critical-host-fluctuations.sketch.txt.

new.title: The exact least mass of an affine error fiber under bounded single-bit likelihood ratios
new.statement:
∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (r R : ℕ), 1 ≤ R →
  let K := ZMod 2
  let X := V → K
  let Y := Fin r → K
  ∀ (H : X →ₗ[K] Y), Function.Surjective H →
    let unit := fun v : V => fun u : V => if u = v then (1 : K) else 0
    let cols := (Finset.univ.image (fun v : V => H (unit v))).erase 0
    let length := fun s : Y => sInf {k : ℕ | ∃ x : X, H x = s ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun v : V => x v ≠ 0)).card = k}
    let Z := ∑ s : Y, R^(length s)
    let smooth := fun μ : X → ℝ => (∀ x, 0 ≤ μ x) ∧ 0 < ∑ x, μ x ∧
      ∀ x v, μ x ≤ (R : ℝ) * μ (x + unit v)
    Z ≤ (R+1)^r ∧ (1 < R → (Z = (R+1)^r ↔ cols.card = r)) ∧
    ∀ y : Y,
      let fiber := Finset.univ.filter (fun x : X => H x = y)
      (∀ μ : X → ℝ, smooth μ → (∑ x, μ x) ≤ (Z : ℝ) * ∑ x ∈ fiber, μ x) ∧
      ∃ μ : X → ℝ, smooth μ ∧ (∑ x, μ x) = (Z : ℝ) * ∑ x ∈ fiber, μ x
new.unlocks: Converts affine sets of clause-search errors into quantitative error lower bounds under correlated sources, with the exact dependence on the physical bit coordinates.
new.context: For each syndrome s choose a shortest raw flip vector producing s. Translating the target fiber by it gives a bijection to the shifted fiber and multiplies mass by at most R to its weight. Sum over syndromes. Weight each input by R to its distance from the target fiber to attain equality. Choose a basis of columns. Each syndrome costs at most its basis weight. Extra nonzero columns outside that basis strictly shorten their own syndrome, while repetitions and zero columns shorten none.

new.title: The accuracy budget for graph pigeonhole clause search under correlated sources with bounded neighboring mass ratios
new.statement:
∃ C n₀ : ℕ, 2 ≤ C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n →
  ∃ G : PEqualNP.Expanders.BipGraph (n+1) n,
    PEqualNP.Expanders.LeftDegLe G C ∧ PEqualNP.Expanders.RightDegLe G C ∧
    let V := PEqualNP.Expanders.GEdge G
    let X := V → Bool
    let e := Fintype.card V
    let F := PEqualNP.Expanders.funGraphPHP G
    ∀ (b T h R : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin b → ZMod 2)) (cap : (Fin b → ZMod 2) → ℕ),
      1 ≤ R → S.Nonempty → (∀ y ∈ S, 1 ≤ cap y) →
      let Y := Fin b → ZMod 2
      let flat := sSup {k : ℕ | ∃ (U : Submodule (ZMod 2) Y) (y : Y),
        Module.finrank (ZMod 2) U = k ∧ ∀ u ∈ U, y + u ∈ S}
      let B := min (∑ y ∈ S, cap y) (T + S.sup cap + flat)
      let L := Nat.clog 2 (R+1)
      let smooth := fun μ : X → ℝ => (∀ x, 0 ≤ μ x) ∧ 0 < ∑ x, μ x ∧
        ∀ x v, μ x ≤ (R : ℝ) * μ (Function.update x v (!(x v)))
      let possible := fun (allSources : Bool) => ∃ (H : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit)
          (pick : Fin b → Fin (2+e+H.size)) (out : Y → Finset (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause V)),
        PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (2+e) H ∧
        (∀ g ∈ H.gates, ((g.op = .and ∨ g.op = .or) ∧ g.inputs.length = 2) ∨
          g.op = .mod 2 ∨ (g.op = .not ∧ g.inputs.length = 1)) ∧
        H.gates.countP (fun g => @decide (g.op = .and ∨ g.op = .or) (Classical.propDecidable _)) ≤ T ∧
        (∀ y ∈ S, (out y).card ≤ cap y ∧ ∀ cl ∈ out y, cl ∈ F) ∧
        let msg := fun (x : X) (j : Fin b) =>
          let ws := H.wires ([false,true] ++ List.ofFn (fun i : Fin e => x ((Fintype.equivFin V).symm i)))
          ((ws.getD (pick j).val false).toNat : ZMod 2)
        (∀ x : X, msg x ∈ S) ∧
        let bad := Finset.univ.filter (fun x : X =>
          @decide (∀ cl ∈ out (msg x), PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.ClauseSat x cl) (Classical.propDecidable _))
        let accurate := fun μ : X → ℝ => (2 : ℝ)^h * (∑ x ∈ bad, μ x) ≤ ∑ x, μ x
        if allSources then (∀ μ, smooth μ → accurate μ) else (∃ μ, smooth μ ∧ accurate μ)
      (possible false → min (n*L) h ≤ C*L*B) ∧
      (C * min n ((R+1)^C*h) ≤ B → possible true)
new.unlocks: For each fixed neighbor ratio, determines the resource scale for error 2^-h on one graph family all the way from constant error to exact search.
new.context: If all listed clauses have a common satisfying input, pin one literal per clause to force failure. Otherwise the union gives exact constant-message search. A failed input also lies on a circuit region made affine by T queries. Fix its word with at most flat-dimension more parities and pin one true literal per listed clause. Either bound on error-flat codimension gives mass by the syndrome lemma. For the upper bound test disjoint pigeon rows. Conditional on any prior outcomes a fresh row is all zero with probability at least (R+1)^(-width). Batch the rows or use exact search.

new.title: Guaranteed accuracy on every product-parity input pair has exact expected one-way cost
new.statement:
∀ (a k : Nat), 0 < a → 0 < k →
  ∃ m₀ : Nat, 0 < m₀ ∧ ∀ m : Nat, m₀ ≤ m →
    let A := Fin (2^a)
    let B := Fin k
    let X := Fin m → A
    let Y := Fin m → B
    ∀ f : Fin m → A → B → Bool,
    (∀ i u v, u ≠ v →
      (∃ j, f i u j = f i v j) ∧ (∃ j, f i u j ≠ f i v j)) →
    ∀ (left : X → Bool) (right : Y → Bool),
      let truth := fun (x : X) (y : Y) =>
        xor (xor (left x) (right y))
          (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).filter (fun i => f i (x i) (y i))).card % 2 == 1)
      ∀ β : ℚ, 0 ≤ β → β ≤ 1 →
        let costs : Set ℚ := {c | ∃ (r : Nat) (send : Fin r → X → List Bool)
          (read : Fin r → List Bool → Y → Bool),
          0 < r ∧
          (∀ z x x' tail, send z x ++ tail = send z x' → tail = []) ∧
          (∀ x y, (1+β)*(r : ℚ) ≤ 2*(((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin r)).filter
            (fun z => read z (send z x) y = truth x y)).card : ℚ)) ∧
          c = ((∑ z : Fin r, ∑ x : X, (send z x).length : Nat) : ℚ) /
            ((r : ℚ)*((2^a)^m : Nat))}
        IsLeast costs (β*(a*m : Nat))
new.unlocks: Gives an exact pointwise one-way cost on guarded equality parity for comparison with the near-perfect two-message protocol.
new.context: Pair two distinct Alice words and sample Bob at a disagreement. This keeps Alice uniform and forces zero silent bias. Pair correlations decay geometrically in Hamming distance, so every conditional Bob law is exponentially close to uniform in L1. Small nonsingleton classes retain a strict bias gap. Holder bounds large-class bias exponentially. Average log(1/mass) using Kraft, except for a near-full class where any nonconstant code spends at least one bit. Reveal Alice with probability b and guess fairly on the remaining seeds.

new.title: Sampling a disagreement balances every column and bounds the change in each row distribution
new.statement:
∀ (n k : Nat), 2 ≤ n → 0 < k → ∀ f : Fin n → Fin k → Bool,
  (∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∃ y, f i y ≠ f j y) →
  let sign := fun (i : Fin n) (y : Fin k) => if f i y then (-1 : ℚ) else 1
  let diff := fun (i j : Fin n) =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k)).filter (fun y => f i y ≠ f j y)).card
  let P := fun (i : Fin n) (y : Fin k) =>
    (∑ j : Fin n, if f i y ≠ f j y then (1 : ℚ) / diff i j else 0) / ((n : ℚ)-1)
  let corr := fun (i j : Fin n) => (∑ y : Fin k, sign i y * sign j y) / (k : ℚ)
  let silent := (∑ y : Fin k, |(∑ j : Fin n, sign j y) / (n : ℚ)|) / (k : ℚ)
  (∀ i y, 0 ≤ P i y) ∧ (∀ i, (∑ y : Fin k, P i y) = 1) ∧
  (∀ y, (∑ i : Fin n, P i y * sign i y) = 0) ∧
  ∀ i, ((n : ℚ)-1) * (∑ y : Fin k, |P i y - 1/(k : ℚ)|) ≤
    (n : ℚ)*silent + ∑ j : Fin n, |corr i j|
new.unlocks: Constructs a hard law with uniform Alice input and no silent bias while preserving bias estimates on each one-way message class.
new.context: At each column swap the two sampled rows. Their opposite signs have identical weights. The pairwise disagreement density relative to uniform is (1-R_i R_j)/(1-c_ij). Dropping the denominator changes the density by exactly |c_ij| in mean absolute value. Averaging the numerators over j other than i leaves a deviation from one bounded in mean by (n*gamma+1)/(n-1), by restoring the omitted row. Its self-correlation is one, giving the stated sum.

changed.title: Every block length at least the window width supports many independently switchable endpoint pairs in both directions
changed.statement:
∀ (d L : Nat),
  let w := d+1
  let D := 2^w
  w ≤ L →
    let X := Fin w → Bool
    let S := Fin L × (Fin (w+1) → Bool)
    ∃ (m : Nat) (edge : Fin m → X × X) (base : S → Bool) (port : Bool → Fin m → S),
      D * min L D ≤ 20*m ∧ Function.Injective edge ∧

changed.title: Exact count of binary isotropic subspaces with a prescribed projection on one side of a bipartite graph
changed.statement:
∀ (l r m d : ℕ) (edge : Fin l → Fin r → Prop)
  (p : Fin l → Fin m → ZMod 2) (h : Fin r → Fin m → ZMod 2)
  (Y : Submodule (ZMod 2) (Fin l → ZMod 2)),
  letI : ∀ q : Prop, Decidable q := Classical.propDecidable
  let F := ZMod 2
  let A := Fin m → F
  let W := (Fin l → F) × (Fin r → F)
  letI : Fintype (Submodule F W) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let ev := fun (i : Fin l) (y : Y) => y.val i
  let neigh := fun j : Fin r =>
    Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin l => edge i j ∧ ev i ≠ 0)
  let free := Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin r => (neigh j).card = 0)
  let tied := Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin r => ((neigh j).image ev).card = 1)
  let D := Submodule.span F (↑(free.image h) : Set A)
  let v := fun (j : Fin r) (y : Y) =>
    (∑ g ∈ (neigh j).image ev, g y) • D.mkQ (h j)
  let T := Submodule.span F (↑(tied.image v) : Set (Y → (A ⧸ D)))
  let offset := fun y : Y => D.mkQ (∑ i, ev i y • p i)
  let e := Module.finrank F Y
  let k := free.card - Module.finrank F D
  let good := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    Module.finrank F U = d ∧
    (∀ x : Fin l → F, x ∈ Y ↔ ∃ z : Fin r → F, (x,z) ∈ U) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ b : Fin m, (∑ i, p i b * x.1 i) + (∑ j, h j b * x.2 j) = 0) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i j, edge i j → x.1 i * y.2 j = y.1 i * x.2 j)
  (Finset.univ.filter good).card =
    if e ≤ d ∧ d ≤ e+k ∧ offset ∈ T then
      2^(tied.card - Module.finrank F T) *
        Nat.card {K : Submodule F (Fin k → F) // Module.finrank F K = d-e} *
        2^(e*(k-(d-e)))
    else 0

changed.title: Full parity lookup at two-thirds agreement costs at least the affine row dimension minus three binary AND/OR gates
changed.statement:
∀ k : ℕ, 64 ≤ k →
  let F := ZMod 2
  let V := Fin k → F
  ∃ t : ℕ, let m := 2^t
    512*k ≤ m ∧ m < 1024*k ∧
    ∃ s : Fin (2^(k+m-1)),
      let v := fun (j : Fin m) (i : Fin k) =>
        if s.val.testBit (j.val+i.val) then (1 : F) else 0
      let inp := fun (x : V) (j : Fin m) =>
        List.ofFn (fun i : Fin k => decide (x i = 1)) ++ List.ofFn (fun l : Fin t => j.val.testBit l.val)
      let legal := fun (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
        PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (k+t) C ∧
        (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2 ∧
          (g.op = .and ∨ g.op = .or ∨ g.op = .mod 2 ∨ (g.op = .not ∧ g.inputs.length = 1)))
      let cost := fun (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
        C.gates.countP (fun z => @decide
          ((z.op = .and ∨ z.op = .or) ∧ z.inputs.length = 2) (Classical.propDecidable _))
      (∃ H, legal H ∧ H.output < k+t+H.size ∧ cost H ≤ m-1 ∧
        ∀ x j, H.eval (inp x j) = decide (dotProduct (v j) x = 1)) ∧
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (B : (Fin n → F) →ₗ[F] V), Function.Injective B →
      ∀ (p : V) (K : Finset (Fin m)) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), legal C →
        let hits := ∑ j ∈ K, ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n → F)).filter (fun y =>
          C.eval (inp (p+B y) j) = decide (dotProduct (v j) (p+B y) = 1))).card
        let N := 2^n
        (∀ h : ℕ, cost C+h ≤ n →
          14*2^h*(2*hits-N*K.card) ≤ (2^h+13)*N*m) ∧
        (m ≤ 2*K.card → 2*N*K.card ≤ 3*hits → n ≤ cost C+3) ∧
        (K = Finset.univ → hits = N*K.card → n ≤ cost C)

changed.title: The full two-slice agreement region for binary AND/OR circuits computing inner product with a quadratic switch
changed.statement:
∀ (n r s : ℕ),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let V := Fin n → F
  let quad := fun (q : V → F) =>
    ∃ (b : F) (a : V) (M : Fin n → Fin n → F), ∀ v,
      q v = b + dotProduct a v + ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * v i * v j
  let Circ := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit
  let legal := fun (n : ℕ) (C : Circ) =>
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack n C ∧
      (∀ h ∈ C.gates, h.inputs.length ≤ 2 ∧
        (h.op = .and ∨ h.op = .or ∨ h.op = .mod 2 ∨ (h.op = .not ∧ h.inputs.length = 1)))
  let cost := fun (C : Circ) => C.gates.countP (fun h => @decide
    ((h.op = .and ∨ h.op = .or) ∧ h.inputs.length = 2) (Classical.propDecidable _))
  let bits := fun (n : ℕ) (u : Fin n → F) => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin n => decide (u j = 1))
  ∀ (Q : Bool → V → F) (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) F), (∀ t, quad (Q t)) →
    let d := fun u : V => Q false u + Q true u
    M.rank = 2*r → (∀ u v, d (u+v) + d u + d v + d 0 = dotProduct u (M.mulVec v)) →
    let k := n+1
    let score := fun (C : Circ) (t : Bool) =>
      (∑ x : Fin k → F, ∑ u : V,
        let y : Fin k → F := Fin.cons (if t then 1 else 0) u
        if C.eval (bits k x ++ bits k y) = decide (dotProduct x y + Q t u = 1)
        then (1 : ℚ) else -1) / 2^(k+n)
    let rho : ℚ := if s < k then 1 / 2^(n-s) else 1
    let total : ℚ := if s < k then rho else 1 + 1 / 2^(r-(s-k))
    (∀ v : Bool → ℚ,
      (∃ (C : Fin 3 → Circ) (p : Fin 3 → ℚ),
        (∀ i, legal (2*k) (C i) ∧ cost (C i) ≤ s ∧ 0 ≤ p i) ∧
        (∑ i, p i) = 1 ∧ ∀ t, v t = ∑ i, p i * score (C i) t) ↔
      |v false| ≤ rho ∧ |v true| ≤ rho ∧ |v false| + |v true| ≤ total) ∧
    ((∃ C : Circ, legal (2*k) C ∧ cost C ≤ s ∧ ∀ t, score C t = 1) ↔ k+r ≤ s)
changed.unlocks: Prices a coupled quadratic pair at every budget and gives the best bias at any selector frequency.
changed.context: Decompose the row sign into realizable signed flats. A flat of dimension d has total conditional mass 2^(d−n) across the two slices. Below k use an s-flat inside the chosen slice and fit its quadratic using free affine taps. At or above k any proper flat has mass at most one. On the full flat the shared address circuit has s−k gates, giving the stated sum bound and both extreme pairs. Free selector corrections change signs independently. Triangulate the polygon for rational mixtures of three circuits. A cheaper exact circuit cannot exist because its two biases must both be one.

changed.title: Logarithmic-girth boundary expanders with a minimal Hall violation at every scale
changed.statement:
∃ C Q₀ : ℕ, 2 ≤ C ∧ ∀ Q : ℕ, Q₀ ≤ Q →
  ∃ q : ℕ, 2 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ Q ∧ Q ≤ C*q ∧
    ∃ G : PEqualNP.Expanders.BipGraph (q+1) q,
      PEqualNP.Expanders.IsBdryExpander G (Q/C) 2 ∧
      (∀ u, 2 ≤ (G u).card ∧ (G u).card ≤ 16) ∧
      (∀ v, 2 ≤ (PEqualNP.Expanders.rightNbrs G v).card ∧
        (PEqualNP.Expanders.rightNbrs G v).card ≤ 16) ∧
      (∀ T : Finset (Fin (q+1)), T ≠ Finset.univ → T.card ≤ (T.biUnion G).card) ∧
      (∀ f : Fin (q+1) ⊕ Fin q → Bool,
        (∀ u, ∀ v ∈ G u, f (Sum.inl u) = f (Sum.inr v)) → ∀ x y, f x = f y) ∧
      ∀ (a : ℕ) (us : Fin (a+2) ↪ Fin (q+1)) (vs : Fin (a+2) ↪ Fin q),
        (∀ i, vs i ∈ G (us i) ∧ vs i ∈ G (us (i+1))) →
        Nat.clog 2 Q ≤ C*(2*(a+2))

changed.context: Use a random bipartite degree-16 configuration on Q+Q. A union bound gives over 10s neighbors for s <= Q/C. Expose a short-radius ball per vertex. Its chance of two collision pairings is O(16^(4r)/Q^2), so short cycles, including double edges, are vertex-disjoint. Delete one edge per such cycle and one hole. At least 4s-s-1 unique neighbors survive. Take an inclusion-minimal deficient pigeon set and its entire neighborhood. This gives imbalance one, connectivity and right degree at least two.

changed.title: The number of distinct attainable count sets under pins for two perfect matchings
changed.statement:
∀ n : ℕ,
  let V := Bool × Fin n
  let Match := Bool → Equiv.Perm (Fin n)
  let Index := Fin (n+1) × Fin (n+1)
  let support := fun (M : Match) (pin : V → Option Bool) =>
    (Finset.univ : Finset Index).filter (fun d =>
      0 < ((Finset.univ : Finset (V → Bool)).filter (fun x =>
        (∀ v, pin v = none ∨ pin v = some (x v)) ∧
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => x (false,i) ≠ x (true,M false i))).card = d.1.val ∧
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => x (false,i) ≠ x (true,M true i))).card = d.2.val)).card)
  let classes := fun M : Match =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (V → Option Bool)).image (support M)).card
  (∀ M : Match, classes M ≤ (n+1)^8) ∧
    ∃ M : Match, (n/16+1)^8 ≤ classes M

changed.title: Counting physical pin patterns with a prescribed matching histogram represents three-partition
changed.statement:
∀ (t b : ℕ) (s : (Fin (t+1) × Fin 3) → ℕ),
  let m := t+1
  let B := b+1
  let K := Fin m × Fin 3
  let len := fun i : K => s i + 1
  (∑ i : K, len i) = m*B → (∀ i, B < 4*len i ∧ 2*len i < B) →
  let I := (i : K) × Fin (s i+1)
  let T := Fin m × Fin B
  let J := Fin (m*B+1)
  let source := fun (d : J × J) =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset ((Bool × I) → Bool)).filter (fun x =>
      (∀ i : K, x (false,(⟨i,0⟩ : I)) = false) ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : I => x (false,i) ≠ x (true,i))).card = d.1.val ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : I => x (false,i) ≠ x (true,(⟨i.1,i.2+1⟩ : I)))).card = d.2.val)).card
  let hist := fun (p : Bool × T → Option Bool) (d : J × J) =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset ((Bool × T) → Bool)).filter (fun x =>
      (∀ v, p v = none ∨ p v = some (x v)) ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : T => x (false,i) ≠ x (true,i))).card = d.1.val ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : T => x (false,i) ≠ x (true,(i.1,i.2+1)))).card = d.2.val)).card
  let good := Finset.univ.filter (fun p => hist p = source)
  let slots := (Finset.univ : Finset (Equiv.Perm K)).filter (fun π =>
    ∀ c : Fin m, (∑ u : Fin 3, len (π (c,u))) = B)
  let copies := ∏ j : Fin (B+1), ((Finset.univ : Finset K).filter (fun i => len i = j.val)).card.factorial
  (∀ p, (∀ d, hist p d * 2^(2*m*B-3*m) =
    source d * 2^((Finset.univ.filter (fun v => p v = none)).card)) ↔ p ∈ good) ∧
    (good.Nonempty ↔ slots.Nonempty) ∧
    3^m * copies * good.card = (4*B)^m * slots.card

changed.title: Rejected conjunction probes determine the cost of merging polynomial-calculus proofs at search leaves
changed.statement:
∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (F : Set (MvPolynomial V (ZMod 2)))
    (leaves : Finset (List Bool)) (ask : List Bool → PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.LinTerm V)
    (E : List Bool → Set (MvPolynomial V (ZMod 2))) (D : List Bool → ℕ),
    let follows := fun (p : List Bool) (x : V → Bool) =>
      ∀ i : Fin p.length, p.get i = true ↔
        PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.LinTermSat x (ask (p.take i.val))
    (∀ p ∈ leaves, ∀ q ∈ leaves, List.IsPrefix p q → p = q) →
    (∀ x : V → Bool, ∃ p ∈ leaves, follows p x) →
    (∀ p ∈ leaves, ∃ x : V → Bool, follows p x) →
    (∀ v : V, MvPolynomial.X v * MvPolynomial.X v + MvPolynomial.X v ∈ F) →
    (∀ p ∈ leaves, ∀ x : V → Bool, follows p x → ∀ e ∈ E p,
      MvPolynomial.eval (fun v => (x v).toNat : V → ZMod 2) e = 0) →
    (∀ p ∈ leaves, PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.PCRefutable (F ∪ E p) (D p)) →
    let copies := fun p : List Bool => ∏ i : Fin p.length,
      if p.get i then 1 else max 1 (ask (p.take i.val)).card
    PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.PCRefutable F
      (Nat.log 2 (∑ p ∈ leaves, copies p * 2^(D p)))

For a binary split, weight the cheaper branch by the complementary affine factor, then replay the other. The maximum child degree suffices except for a tie, which costs one. changed.title: Exact adaptive parity-tree leaf count for masked products with arbitrary finite output lists
changed.statement:
∀ (r L K : ℕ) (_ : 0 < L),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let X := Fin r → Fin 3 → F
  let Y := Fin r → F
  let target := fun (z : X) (i : Fin r) => z i 2 + z i 0 * z i 1
  let k := min r L.log2
  (∃ (N J : Finset (List Bool)) (query : List Bool → X →ₗ[F] F)
     (bias : List Bool → F) (out : List Bool → Finset Y),
    [] ∈ N ∧ J ⊆ N ∧
    (∀ (p : List Bool) (t : Bool), p ++ [t] ∈ N → p ∈ J) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ J, p ++ [false] ∈ N ∧ p ++ [true] ∈ N) ∧
    (N \ J).card ≤ K ∧ ∀ p ∈ N \ J, (out p).card ≤ L ∧
      ∀ z : X, (∀ j : Fin p.length,
        decide (query (p.take j.val) z = bias (p.take j.val)) = p.get j) → target z ∈ out p) ↔
    2^(2*(r-k)) ≤ K
changed.unlocks: Gives the adaptive counterpart for arbitrary positive list size and the exact gain from using one round of prior answers.
changed.context: Project an occupied leaf onto its 2r operand bits. Its vertical mask kernel has dimension at most k. Choose h pivot operand coordinates on this projection; at least h-r blocks have both pivots. Fix the remaining pivots and lift linearly to the masks. On the full pairs each residual is its product plus an affine form. Every prescribed pattern has odd fiber size: multiplying its indicators gives the full squarefree monomial once. Thus h≤r+k. Count leaf sizes. Read one operand of r-k blocks, then each corrected mask using that answer.

changed.title: A boundary of twelve plus eight bits per allowed error determines the parity leaf budget on both cyclic banks
changed.statement:
∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let W := Fin k → F
  let ix := fun j : ℕ => (⟨j % k, Nat.mod_lt _ hk⟩ : Fin k)
  let rot := fun (s : ℕ) (x : W) (i : Fin k) => x (ix (i.val+k-s % k))
  let mix := fun (g : ℕ) (x : W) (i : Fin k) =>
    x i + x (ix (i.val+g)) + x (ix (i.val+k-g % k))
  let step := fun (x : W) (i : Fin k) => x i + (1+x (ix (i.val+1))) * x (ix (i.val+2))
  let D := W →ₗ[F] F
  let seed := (Finset.range 64).image (fun v => v + 64*v)
  let adjoin := fun (s : Finset ℕ) (v : ℕ) => s ∪ s.image (fun u => u ^^^ v)
  ∀ (mark : Bool → Fin k → Bool) (row col c₁ c₂ : W) (e L : Nat),
    let target := fun (x : W) (b : Bool) (i : Fin k) =>
      if mark b i then
        if b then step (mix 2 (rot 3 x + col)) i + rot 4 x i + c₂ i
        else step (mix 1 (rot 1 x + row)) i + x i + c₁ i
      else 0
    let run := fun (T : Finset (List Bool)) (ask : List Bool → D)
        (shift : List Bool → F) (x : W) =>
      (List.range T.card).foldl (fun (p : List Bool) _ =>
        if p ∈ T then p ++ [decide (ask p x+shift p ≠ 0)] else p) []
    (∃ (T : Finset (List Bool)) (ask : List Bool → D) (shift : List Bool → F)
        (P : List Bool → Bool × Fin k → D) (off : List Bool → Bool × Fin k → F),
      T.card < L ∧ ∀ x : W,
        let p := run T ask shift x
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (Bool × Fin k)).filter (fun u =>
          mark u.1 u.2 = true ∧ target x u.1 u.2 ≠ P p u x+off p u)).card ≤ e) ↔
    ∃ (j : Nat) (who : Fin j → Bool × Fin k), j ≤ 4*e ∧ Function.Injective who ∧
      (∀ v, mark (who v).1 (who v).2 = true) ∧
      let Z := Fin j → Fin 2 → F
      ∃ (checks : Finset (Fin (2^(2*j)))) (A : Fin j → Z →ₗ[F] F) (b : Fin j → F)
          (pick : Fin k → Bool → Fin 3),
        (∀ z : Z, (∀ mask ∈ checks, (∑ v : Fin j, ∑ l : Fin 2,
          if mask.val.testBit (2*v.val+l.val) then z v l else 0) = 0) →
          ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin j)).filter
            (fun v => z v 0*z v 1 ≠ A v z+b v)).card ≤ e) ∧
        let put := fun (st : Finset Nat) (i : Fin k) (colSide : Bool) =>
          let site := ix (i.val+4)
          let u : Nat := if colSide then 21 else 56
          let v : Nat := if colSide then 42 else 112
          let clean := if mark colSide site = true ∧ (∀ l, who l ≠ (colSide,site))
            then adjoin st (if (pick i colSide).val = 0 then u
              else if (pick i colSide).val = 1 then v else u ^^^ v) else st
          (List.finRange j).foldl (fun span l => if who l = (colSide,site) then
            adjoin (adjoin span (u + 2^(13+2*l.val))) (v + 2^(14+2*l.val))
            else span) clean
        let last := (List.finRange k).foldl (fun (st : Nat × Finset Nat) i =>
          let shifted := st.2.image (fun v => v % 64 + 128*(v / 64))
          let both := put (put shifted i false) i true
          let even := both.filter (fun v => v % 2 = 0)
          (st.1 + (if even = both then 0 else 1), even.image (fun v => v / 2)))
          ((0,seed) : Nat × Finset Nat)
        let closed := last.2.biUnion (fun v => seed.image (fun u => v ^^^ u))
        let finalSpan := checks.toList.foldl (fun st mask => adjoin st (4096*mask.val)) closed
        2^(last.1 + Nat.log2 finalSpan.card - (12+2*j)) ≤ L

Subtract twelve for the two boundary identifications and two per exception for the defining equations of its operand bits. The remaining rank prices a uniform tree on parallel cosets.

changed.title: An exact parity leaf budget for uniformly bounded errors reduces to at most four exceptional products per allowed mistake
changed.statement:
∀ (n m e L : Nat),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let W := Fin n → F
  let D := W →ₗ[F] F
  let I := Fin m
  let H := List Bool
  ∀ (a b c : I → D) (f g h : I → F),
    let target := fun (x : W) (i : I) => (a i x+f i)*(b i x+g i)+c i x+h i
    let run := fun (T : Finset H) (ask : H → D) (bias : H → F) (x : W) =>
      (List.range T.card).foldl (fun (p : H) _ =>
        if p ∈ T then p ++ [decide (ask p x+bias p ≠ 0)] else p) []
    (∃ (T : Finset H) (ask : H → D) (bias : H → F) (pred : H → I → D) (off : H → I → F),
      T.card < L ∧ ∀ x : W,
        let p := run T ask bias x
        ((Finset.univ : Finset I).filter (fun i => target x i ≠ pred p i x+off p i)).card ≤ e) ↔
    ∃ (J : Finset I) (pick : I → D), J.card ≤ 4*e ∧
      (∀ i ∈ J, pick i = 0) ∧
      (∀ i ∉ J, pick i = a i ∨ pick i = b i ∨ pick i = a i+b i) ∧
      let Z := ↥J → Fin 2 → F
      let value := fun (x : W) (i : ↥J) (v : Fin 2) => if v = 0 then a i.val x else b i.val x
      ∃ (B : Submodule F Z) (P : ↥J → Z →ₗ[F] F) (d : ↥J → F),
        (∀ z ∈ B, ((Finset.univ : Finset ↥J).filter
          (fun i => z i 0*z i 1 ≠ P i z+d i)).card ≤ e) ∧
        2^n ≤ L * ((Finset.univ : Finset W).filter
          (fun x => @decide ((∀ i, pick i x = 0) ∧ value x ∈ B) (Classical.propDecidable _) = true)).card
changed.unlocks: Reduces the joint cyclic error-budget calculation to ordinary rank and a small exceptional operand table.
changed.context: Take a largest leaf and translate it to its direction space. Every product still nonlinear there costs at least a quarter of the inputs in errors. For each other product one operand slope or their sum vanishes. Map the leaf direction to the exceptional operands and use a linear section to transfer the affine predictions. Conversely the entire certified kernel intersection works with those predictions. Its translates partition the cube and changes to each quadratic under translation are affine.

changed.title: Sharp parity tree leaf budgets for a guaranteed number of errors on marked cyclic outputs
changed.statement:
∀ (k : Nat) (hk : 0 < k),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let W := Fin k → F
  let ix := fun n : Nat => (⟨n % k, Nat.mod_lt _ hk⟩ : Fin k)
  let rot := fun (n : Nat) (word : W) (i : Fin k) => word (ix (i.val+k-n % k))
  ∀ (spacing s t : Nat) (name constant : W),
    let out := fun (raw : W) (site : Fin k) =>
      let old := rot s raw + name
      let y := fun u : Fin k =>
        old u + old (ix (u.val+spacing)) + old (ix (u.val+k-spacing % k))
      y site + (1+y (ix (site.val+1)))*y (ix (site.val+2)) + rot t raw site + constant site
    let H := List Bool
    let Tree := Finset H × (H → W →ₗ[F] F) × (H → F) × (H → W →ₗ[F] W) × (H → W)
    let predict : Tree → W → W := fun tree raw =>
      let nodes := tree.1
      let ask := tree.2.1
      let bias := tree.2.2.1
      let aff := tree.2.2.2.1
      let c := tree.2.2.2.2
      let leaf := (List.range nodes.card).foldl (fun (p : H) _ =>
        if p ∈ nodes then p ++ [decide (ask p raw + bias p ≠ 0)] else p) []
      aff leaf raw + c leaf
    let g := Nat.gcd k spacing
    let h := if 3 ∣ k/g then 2*g else 0
    ∀ (sites : Finset (Fin k)) (e : Nat),
      let mu := (sites.powerset.filter (fun E => ∀ i ∈ E, ix (i.val+1) ∉ E)).sup Finset.card
      let extra := if sites = Finset.univ ∧ 1 < k ∧ k % 2 = 1 ∧ e < mu then 1 else 0
      let price := 2^(mu-e+extra)
      let feasible := fun L : Nat =>
        ∃ tree : Tree, tree.1.card < L ∧ ∀ x : W,
          (sites.filter (fun i => predict tree x i ≠ out x i)).card ≤ e
      feasible price ∧ ∀ L : Nat, feasible L → price ≤ 2^h*L

changed.context: At an affine leaf solve for its pivot variables. A matching on the remaining marked edges gives a product of residuals with one squarefree term of highest degree, so all those outputs err together somewhere. Deleting p pivots costs at most p matching edges. On a full odd cycle count the odd path runs to get the extra vertex. For attainment pin part of a minimum cover and predict the tail variable of each free directed edge. Simultaneous errors are binary descents and form a matching.

changed.title: A fan-in-two circuit evaluates every weighted fiber of a binary affine relation at the cost of blocked matrix multiplication
changed.statement:
∀ (a b c m t : Nat),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let X := Fin a → F
  let Y := Fin b → F
  let Z := Fin c → F
  let N := a+b+c
  let w := max a (max b c)
  let inputs := m*(N+1)+(2^a+2^b)*t
  let bitsOut := a+b+2*t+1
  ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit)
    (answer : Fin (2^c) → Fin bitsOut → Fin (inputs+C.size)),
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack inputs C ∧
    C.output = (answer 0 0).val ∧ C.size ≤ 2^60*(N+m+t+4)^30*2^(w % 2)*7^(w/2) ∧
    ∀ (H : Fin m → X × Y × Z) (rhs : Fin m → F)
      (f : Fin (2^a) → Fin (2^t)) (g : Fin (2^b) → Fin (2^t)),
      let pack := fun (s : Nat) (v : Fin s → F) => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin s => decide (v j ≠ 0))
      let bits := (List.finRange m).flatMap (fun i =>
        pack a (H i).1 ++ pack b (H i).2.1 ++ pack c (H i).2.2 ++ [decide (rhs i ≠ 0)]) ++
        (List.finRange (2^a)).flatMap (fun ix => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin t => (f ix).val.testBit j.val)) ++
        (List.finRange (2^b)).flatMap (fun iy => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin t => (g iy).val.testBit j.val))
      let decode := fun (s v : Nat) (j : Fin s) => (if v.testBit j.val then 1 else 0 : F)
      let readWire := fun n : Fin (inputs+C.size) => (C.wires bits).getD n.val false
      let total := fun iz : Fin (2^c) =>
        ∑ ix : Fin (2^a), ∑ iy : Fin (2^b),
          if ∀ i, dotProduct (H i).1 (decode a ix.val) + dotProduct (H i).2.1 (decode b iy.val) +
            dotProduct (H i).2.2 (decode c iz.val) = rhs i then (f ix).val*(g iy).val else 0
      ∀ iz j, readWire (answer iz j) = (total iz).testBit j.val

On the common square blocks use seven integer products per binary split. Route all runtime table indices by sorting and invert the transforms. Inconsistency clears every output.

changed.title: Component sizes count the affine predictions guaranteeing one error per four binary products when every frequency occurs twice
changed.statement:
∀ (n e : Nat),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let W := Fin n → F
  let I := Fin (4*e)
  ∀ a b : I → W,
    (∀ i, a i ≠ 0 ∧ b i ≠ 0 ∧ a i ≠ b i) →
    let freq := fun (i : I) => ({a i, b i, a i+b i} : Finset W)
    let rows := fun v : W => (Finset.univ : Finset I).filter (fun i => v ∈ freq i)
    (∀ i, ∀ v ∈ freq i, (rows v).card = 2) →
    let adj := fun (i j : I) => ∃ v ∈ freq i, v ∈ freq j
    let comp := fun i : I => (Finset.univ : Finset I).filter
      (fun j => @decide (Relation.EqvGen adj i j) (Classical.propDecidable _) = true)
    let comps := (Finset.univ : Finset I).image comp
    let good := (Finset.univ : Finset ((I → W) × (I → F))).filter (fun p =>
      ∀ x : W, ((Finset.univ : Finset I).filter (fun i =>
        dotProduct (p.1 i) x+p.2 i ≠ dotProduct (a i) x*dotProduct (b i) x)).card ≤ e)
    good.card = if ∀ C ∈ comps, 4 ∣ C.card then 2^(2*e+comps.card) else 0

changed.title: An intermediate number of accepted cells forces a seeded circuit to select whole lines
changed.statement:
∀ (N g : ℕ), g+1 < N →
  let X := Fin N
  let Circ := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit
  let legal := fun (h : ℕ) (C : Circ) =>
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (N+N+h) C ∧ C.output < N+N+h+C.size ∧
    ∀ gate ∈ C.gates, gate.inputs.length ≤ 2 ∧
      (gate.op = .and ∨ gate.op = .or ∨ (gate.op = .not ∧ gate.inputs.length = 1))
  let table := fun (h : ℕ) (C : Circ) (w : Fin h → Bool) (x y : X) =>
    C.eval (PEqualNP.Represents.oneEach x y ++ List.ofFn w)
  let area := fun (H : X → X → Bool) =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (X × X)).filter (fun z => H z.1 z.2 = true)).card
  let lineUnion := fun (h : ℕ) (C : Circ) (R S : Finset X) =>
    ∀ (w : Fin h → Bool) (x y : X), table h C w x y = decide (x ∈ R ∨ y ∈ S)
  ∀ (h : ℕ) (C : Circ), legal h C → C.size ≤ g →
    (∃ w : Fin h → Bool, g*N < area (table h C w) ∧ area (table h C w) < N*(N-g)) →
    ∃ R S : Finset X, R.card + S.card = g+1 ∧ lineUnion h C R S
changed.unlocks: This would determine the complete circuit output from the accepted area on one seed.
changed.context: Trim to the output. Unnamed row-column pairs agree. If they are accepted, monotonicity forces a NOT because there is a rejected pair. Its unary slot leaves at most g names, too few to cover the rejected cells. Otherwise the accepted area forces g+1 names. Equality in the cone edge count gives a binary tree with distinct name leaves and no seed. If an AND occurs, replace it by one child. This only enlarges acceptance and removes a leaf, so the area was at most gN. Every gate in the output cone is OR.

changed.title: Reusing k mixed input ORs saves k gates when replacing a negated row-column OR on the one-hot promise
changed.statement:
∀ (n m k : Nat) (A : Fin n → Fin m → Bool) (u : Fin n) (v : Fin m)
    (x : Fin k ↪ Fin n) (y : Fin k ↪ Fin m) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
  1 ≤ k → k+2 ≤ n → k+2 ≤ m →
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (n+m) C →
  PEqualNP.Represents.Represents A C →
  C.gates[0]? = some ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or, [u.val,n+v.val]⟩ →
  C.gates[1]? = some ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not, [n+m]⟩ →
  (∀ g ∈ C.gates.drop 2, g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) →
  (∀ h, x h ≠ u ∧ y h ≠ v ∧ A (x h) v = true ∧ A u (y h) = true ∧
    ∃ g ∈ C.gates.drop 2, g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧ g.inputs = [(x h).val,n+(y h).val]) →
  PEqualNP.Represents.RepSizeAtMost A (C.size + (n+m-(4+k)))

changed.context: Move the k mixed input ORs first and OR their outputs into Q. In each bank OR all inputs except the switch input and the k paired inputs. Substitute Q OR (left remainder AND right remainder) for the NOT. This equals its old signal except at crossed pairs of a switch input and a paired input, where it grows from false to true. The original output there was true and the suffix is positive. The two remainder lists are nonempty. Their ORs, the Q tree and the final two gates cost n+m-3-k. Remove the old NOT.
